title: GTA 6 £349 Vice City Collection Announced Without Game
description: Rockstar Games has revealed the Goodtime State Vice City collection for GTA 6, priced at £349. Pre-orders are live now, but the bundle does not include the game.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 £349 Vice City Collection Announced Without Game

As anticipation for Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster continues to reach fever pitch, the developer has surprised fans with a brand-new physical merchandise drop. However, this latest announcement isn't a new trailer or a gameplay deep-dive—it's a pricey collection of physical goodies that will set dedicated fans back a hefty sum.

According to a report by gaming media outlet Eurogamer, Rockstar Games has announced the limited "Goodtime State Vice City" collection for *Grand Theft Auto 6*. Priced at a staggering £349, the bundle features a selection of naughty collectables inspired by the game's iconic setting, and pre-orders are currently open.

### A Pricey Package That Omits the Game

While Rockstar's official merchandise has historically appealed to die-hard collectors, the £349 price tag on the Goodtime State Vice City collection has raised eyebrows across the gaming community. 

Perhaps the most crucial detail for prospective buyers is that **this expensive bundle does not include a copy of the game**. Players who choose to pre-order the £349 collection will still need to purchase *Grand Theft Auto 6* separately. 

### Naughty Collectables Inspired by Vice City

The collection leans heavily into the chaotic, sun-drenched aesthetic of Vice City. Eurogamer playfully described the items as a box of "naughty GTA 6 collectables you definitely wouldn't get through airport security," hinting at the bold and provocative nature of the physical items included in the box.

Pre-orders are live now, though quantities are expected to be limited given the niche and premium nature of Rockstar's physical collector drops. Whether the appeal of owning an exclusive piece of Vice City memorabilia justifies the steep price point without a game included will ultimately depend on the dedication of the fanbase.

### Editor's Take

Rockstar knows how to monetize its monumental IP, and the £349 price point for a merch-only bundle proves it. While skipping the game disc might alienate casual buyers, hardcore collectors will likely jump at the chance. It's an extravagant piece of GTA history—just make sure you leave it at home when heading to the airport.
